tiles.markdown:
# Chaos Troop - canary
Experiments that the troop runs land here. Each run drops `CUSTOM_INFO` timeline markers (`Chaos experiment started/ended`) and an `ERROR_EVENT`/metric/log tagged `chaos.run_id`. **Nothing here is a real incident** - it is the tool proving whether your monitoring would have noticed a fault.

- **Fault metric** below spikes when the driver injects a `METRIC` fault (`chaos.canary.fault`).
- **Problems** shows what Davis opened on the canary zone during a run.
- Filter the Events view by `chaos.run_id` to follow one run end to end.

_Example dashboard - adjust the management-zone filter and metric selector to your tenant._

tiles.name: Chaos run markers
tiles.markdown:
## Follow one run
Every run emits timeline markers. In **Observe & Explore > Events** (Classic) or with DQL (Latest), filter on `chaos.run_id` to see: `Chaos experiment started` -> the injected fault -> `Chaos experiment ended:<VERDICT>`. A `KILLED` verdict means the mutation broke detection - **verify by hand; do not automate on it in v0.**
